How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: It was easy to change courses during the semester. But the system is completely different, and it was stressful not knowing if I was registered in any courses. But when that was figured out, it was very easy to register to courses.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: I got help by email.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I got all the classes I wanted, except for those that were not created.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: You can change courses almost throughout the whole semester, so the easiest way is just to pick some, show up to the classes the first week and figure how which corses is interesting.
